purpose: Concept sketches, not screenshots of implemented software.

images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate one polished, highly intuitive Chinese concept illustration, landscape 16:9, high resolution. This is image 1 of a coordinated three-image explanation of a file-based AI research workbench. Audience: its creator who finds abstract architecture hard to visualize. Communicate through actual depicted artifacts and spatial relationships, not a wall of boxes or text. White background, restrained editorial technical illustration, slightly dimensional paper/folder/browser objects, crisp near-black typography, blue for work/content, teal for evidence, amber for human decisions, purple for history, ample whitespace. Elegant, mature, no robots, no decorative network spaghetti.

Large exact title: "01  一份工作，两种看法"
Subtitle: "概念草案"
Three clear zones from left to right, each with a large short label.
LEFT label "Folder · 保存与归属". Draw a real-looking folder tree with readable nested labels in order: "Project", "Theme", "Block", "Job", "Task". Beneath Task are TWO sibling branches, "draft.md" (paper document icon with a blue S17 badge) and "Run" (folder with small result document). This shows draft content and execution within the same ownership hierarchy; don't put Brick beneath Run. No personal paths.
CENTER label "同一份工作". A large blue paper slip with identity badge "S17" and the sentence "模型 A 的误差更低。" The slip links upward to a small question note "研究问题" and left-below to a teal evidence sheet "比较结果". Depict a simple support relation with an arrow from the teal evidence to the S17 slip labelled "支持". The folder's draft.md has a thin dashed association to this slip labelled "保存". These are representations of the same source, NOT three separate databases.
RIGHT label "UI · 阅读与操作". Two miniature recognizable browser panels stacked, titled "Report" and "Review". Each highlights the SAME blue S17 sentence "模型 A 的误差更低。". Report looks like clean prose among a few grey placeholder lines. Review shows the same highlighted sentence with a tiny amber comment bubble. Two blue projection lines from the central S17 to these panels, with shared label "呈现". Browser geometry and clear highlights, not screenshots.
At bottom, a single gentle purple history ribbon under the central work, one small annotation "Session 记录改变与理由". A short line connects it to S17. It is supporting history, not another level in the folder tree.
Bottom takeaway in larger type: "文件保存它，页面呈现它；内容始终是同一个。"
Only the specified short labels, no additional explanatory paragraphs, no false claims of implemented features. Render simplified Chinese correctly and legibly. Everything including title fits with generous margins.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate one highly intuitive Chinese concept illustration, landscape 16:9, high resolution, image 2 of a coordinated series about an AI research workbench. White background, mature editorial technical illustration with gently dimensional paper artifacts, crisp near-black Chinese text, blue content, teal evidence, amber human attention, purple history. Match a restrained research product design, abundant whitespace, no robots, no decorative textures. Concrete artifact-based composition, not a dense architecture chart.

Large exact title: "02  一个 Brick，多处出现"
Small subtitle: "概念草案 · 以一句结论为例"
A large central blue-edged content card, visually the hero, carrying badge "S17", label "Brick · 结论", sentence "模型 A 的误差更低。", and small version chip "v2".
LEFT of card show two modest physical paper artifacts: "draft.md · S17" above and "评论与修改记录" below. A fine association line connects each to the central card, shared label "一个归属". Beneath them a teal evidence paper "比较结果" with a clear support arrow into central card labeled "依据". Keep this compact, visibly supporting the main hero.
RIGHT of hero draw two differently shaped UI treatments of exactly the same S17 content: top a prose section titled "Report" with sentence and blue S17 badge; bottom a review table row titled "Review" with same sentence and blue S17 badge plus small amber comment bubble. Each connects to hero by a blue line. Shared label above these: "多种呈现". This must communicate reuse, not content duplication or independent versions.
BOTTOM third, separated with generous whitespace, a clearly left-to-right version timeline in purple. First mini slip "S17 · v1" with text "模型 A 更好。" and a subdued check with label "曾确认". Arrow to second mini slip "S17 · v2" with text "模型 A 的误差更低。" and amber marker "需重检". Arrow labeled "核对依据" to a third tiny receipt "v2 本版确认" with a green check. The central hero is conceptually the v2 content; bottom is its version history, not different identities.
Bottom takeaway, exact: "身份不随页面变化；确认跟着具体版本。"
No rating number, no UUID, no invented software features, no large raw paths. Small comment bubbles represent records; no long text. Render Chinese accurately. Label this as proposed conceptual behavior, not a screenshot of current implemented UI. Ensure all text large enough to read at normal desktop width.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate one intuitive Chinese illustrated process map, landscape 16:9, high resolution, image 3 of coordinated series on a file-based AI research workbench. White background, mature editorial technical illustration, lightly dimensional paper slips, crisp near-black typography, blue content/work, teal evidence and successful verification, amber human decision, purple history. Wide readable layout, plenty of whitespace, clear arrows with no crossings. Not a wall of text, not a dashboard, no robots.

Exact title: "03  想法怎样长成交付"
Small subtitle: "概念草案"
Main story left-to-right, four substantial illustrated stations:
1 left: a human hand placing a question sticky note, short heading "提出目标", question slip "哪个模型更合适？".
2 center-left: working desk with blue content slip badge "S17" and teal evidence sheet, heading "生成与核对", tiny sublabel "AI · Run / Pass". Slip text "模型 A 的误差更低。".
3 center-right: small assembled report with visibly linked question, evidence and blue conclusion highlights, heading "检查整体", tiny sublabel "回答问题 · 证据一致".
4 right: a clean finished report with a restrained human checkmark, heading "确认交付", small caption "Delivery · 固定版本".

Between station 2 and 3, depict a small clear inspection fork, not a bureaucratic checklist:
One teal path continues to station 3 after verification.
A curved blue loop returns to station 2, label "能确定 → AI 改进".
An amber branch rises to a small human decision desk above with two option cards, heading "需要判断", short caption "人决定方向与取舍"; an amber arrow returns from that decision desk to station 2. This is for uncertainty or choices, never all routine edits.
Above the decision desk, connected with a short purple line, place a modest notebook "Studio" with caption "留下方案与决定". Studio accumulates durable reasoning, it is not an extra required workflow stage.

Under the ENTIRE main flow, a purple horizontal ribbon headed "Session" with three sparse episode dots "目标" "改变" "理由", with fine vertical links into the working stations. Caption on ribbon: "一次推进，留下可追溯的记录". Make it clearly a record of actions, not an extra step after Delivery.
At bottom, exact larger takeaway: "AI 推进确定的工作，人处理关键判断；局部与整体都要检查。"
Keep all specified text short and large. All examples are conceptual, not claims of existing implementation. Correct simplified Chinese. Make the flow and human intervention obvious within 5 seconds.

final_edit.prompt: Edit this concept diagram with one targeted change. Preserve the entire composition, all Chinese and English text, illustrations, palette, all existing arrows, and layout. The decision diamond between 生成与核对 and 检查整体 currently has a teal continuation and blue return loop but no path to the human decision desk. Add a CLEAR AMBER upward branch arrow from the TOP of that diamond to the BOTTOM of the human decision desk titled 需要判断, with short Chinese label “不确定 / 有取舍” beside this new branch. Route this branch in the white gap, avoid crossing any existing text or main illustration, and give it a clear arrowhead entering the human desk. The existing amber arrow from human desk back to 生成与核对 stays intact, so the human intervention loop is visually complete. Do not otherwise redesign, regenerate labels, or add explanatory prose.
